title: What does a data center need?
body: The computers need a steady power supply and cooling. For a proposed site, ask who would pay for grid upgrades and how the operator would report water use.

title: How data center cooling uses water
body: Some cooling systems let water evaporate to carry heat away. Ask how much water the site would need on a hot day and where it would come from.

title: On-site power and local air quality
body: If a site plans to run generators, ask what fuel they would burn, how often they would run and where you can read the air permit.
